ncmec_reports_by_year.note: 1998-2023 exact counts from NCMEC appendix to OJJDP 'CY 2023 Report to the Committees on Appropriations: NCMEC Transparency' (2024). 2024 is NCMEC's rounded figure (20.5 million reports; equivalent to 29.2 million incidents after 'bundling' of viral reports, introduced by Meta in 2024). 2025 exact total from NCMEC 2025 CyberTipline Report. Drop in 2024 attributed by NCMEC partly to bundling and to Meta's default end-to-end encryption on Facebook Messenger (Dec 2023-summer 2024; 6.9 million fewer reports from Facebook).
ncmec_reports_by_year.source: NCMEC / OJJDP CY2023 NCMEC Transparency report, Appendix A; NCMEC 2024 and 2025 CyberTipline Reports

ncmec_by_country.note: All 244 rows NCMEC lists, including 'Europol' (reports associated with multiple EU jurisdictions, listed separately), 'Unknown' (3.33 million; location undeterminable, sent to US federal law enforcement) and 'Grand total' (23,399,834 — higher than the 21.35 million reports because one report can be made available to more than one country). NCMEC states these numbers are not indicative of the level of child sexual abuse in a country; they reflect where uploaders are located, affected by proxies and the size of a country's online population. Null = cell blank in the PDF.

columns: unsolicited obscene material sent to child
ncmec_by_category.note: 2024: NCMEC gives only 'more than 546,000' online enticement and 26,823 child sex trafficking reports. Growth in 2024-2025 enticement and trafficking reports is attributed by NCMEC to the REPORT Act (2024), which made those categories mandatory for platforms. 2025 'extraterritorial child sexual abuse and exploitation' replaces 'child sex tourism'.

ncmec_gai.note: 2025: 'more than 400,000' reports with a GAI nexus per NCMEC CyberTipline data page (the 'first look' blog gave 1.5 million incl. 1.1 million non-actionable Amazon AI Services reports); more than 182,000 involved possessing, generating or attempting to generate GAI CSAM. Since 2023 more than 275 victims of GAI CSAM identified.
ncmec_gai.source: NCMEC CyberTipline Reports 2023-2025; NCMEC CyberTipline data page

sextortion.note: NCMEC: 'nearly 100' financial sextortion reports a day in 2024, average 137/day in 2025 (+37%); 'more than 80,000' 2025 reports concerning sextortion; at least three dozen US teenage boys have died by suicide after financial sextortion since 2021. Sadistic online exploitation / violent online groups: more than 1,300 reports in 2024, more than 3,000 in 2025.
sextortion.iwf_note: IWF actioned reports featuring sexually coerced extortion: 175 in 2024 (138 involving boys), 397 in 2025 (+127%); 748 over 2023-2025, 92% boys, 98% aged 14-17. Source: IWF Annual Data & Insights Reports 2024/2025. https://www.iwf.org.uk/annual-data-insights-report-2025/emerging-and-persistent-harms/sexually-coerced-extortion/

iwf_actioned_by_year.unit: reports confirmed by IWF as containing, linking to or advertising child sexual abuse imagery
iwf_actioned_by_year.note: 2019 rounded to nearest 100 by IWF. 2023 figure is confirmed webpage URLs (plus 6 newsgroup reports). 2025: 311,610 reports, of which 310,437 were URLs. Reports assessed: 2018 229,328; 2019 260,400; 2021 361,062; 2023 392,665; 2024 424,047. Years 1996-2010 and 2012-2017 not obtained. IWF began proactive searching in 2014, which drives much of the growth; figures are not a measure of global prevalence.
iwf_actioned_by_year.source: IWF annual reports and press releases (2019 release, 2021 news, Annual Report 2021/2022/2023, Annual Data & Insights Reports 2024 and 2025)

columns: hosting country as listed by IWF
iwf_hosting_by_country.note: Location of the server hosting the content, traced by IWF; one or two abused hosting services can move a country's share sharply (e.g. Bulgaria +19 points in 2025 from 'just a few particular sites'). '.onion' rows cannot be attributed to a country. UK hosted 0.3%. Historic: UK hosted 18% of IWF-found content in 1996 vs 0.04% in 2018 (IWF via Wikipedia). Netherlands share: 41% (2021), 32% (2022), 33% (2023), 29% (2024), 11% (2025). US share: 21% (2021), 15% (2022-2023), 14% (2024), 16% (2025).
iwf_hosting_by_country.source: IWF Annual Data & Insights Report 2025, Geographic insights (published 23 April 2026)

iwf_hosting_top10_2023.note: Top ten only; Switzerland jump due chiefly to two sites. Netherlands 2022: 82,605; US 2022: 37,285.

iwf_ai.note: 2025: 4,586 of 449,298 criminal images (1%) were AI-generated; 3,443 of 63,682 criminal videos were AI-generated (over 260 times the 13 seen in 2024); 65% of AI videos Category A vs 43% of non-AI videos; 97% of AI images depicted girls. July 2024 IWF snapshot: 3,512 AI CSAM images and videos on one dark web forum in 30 days.
iwf_ai.source: IWF Annual Data & Insights Reports 2024 and 2025
